meta.name: arduino-azure-iot-edge-integration
meta.description: Design and implement Arduino integration with Azure IoT Hub and IoT Edge, including secure provisioning, resilient telemetry, command handling, and production guardrails.

copy.tagline: 将 Arduino 设备安全接入 Azure IoT 云平台
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Arduino 做 IoT 项目并需要连接 Azure 云服务。
copy.tagline_en: Securely connect Arduino devices to Azure IoT cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building IoT projects with Arduino and need Azure cloud integration.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会帮你设计和实现 Arduino 设备与 Azure IoT Hub 及 IoT Edge 的集成，涵盖安全配置、可靠遥测、命令处理和生产防护。
howto.when: 当你需要将 Arduino 类设备连接到 Azure IoT，尤其是涉及网关、不稳定网络、离线缓存或本地执行等边缘场景时触发。

say.text: 我想把 Arduino 传感器连接到 Azure。
say.note: Claude 会提供连接方案和架构建议。

say.text: 如何向 IoT Hub 发送 MQTT 遥测数据？
say.note: Claude 会给出协议和消息格式细节。

say.text: 我需要一个边缘网关来汇聚现场设备数据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps design and implement Arduino integration with Azure IoT Hub and IoT Edge, covering secure provisioning, resilient telemetry, command handling, and production guardrails.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to connect Arduino-class devices to Azure IoT, especially in edge-heavy scenarios like gateways, intermittent networks, offline buffering, and local actuation.

say_en.text: I want to connect Arduino sensors to Azure.
say_en.note: Claude will provide connection plan and architecture.

say_en.text: How do I send MQTT telemetry to IoT Hub?
say_en.note: Claude will detail protocol and message format.

say_en.text: I need an edge gateway for field devices.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend Pattern B and design gateway logic.
